// Generated by the Codename One Python transpiler.
package @PACKAGE@;

import com.codename1.python.runtime.PyFileSystem;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;

/// The file system of a backend build: the host's, through `java.io`, with
/// the working directory the process started in. Generated only into a
/// backend build -- an application's is `FileSystemStorage`, which the
/// backend's class library does not have.
final class BackendFileSystem extends PyFileSystem {
    private BackendFileSystem() {
    }

    static void install() {
        if (!PyFileSystem.installed()) {
            PyFileSystem.install(new BackendFileSystem());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public String home() {
        String h = new File(".").getAbsolutePath().replace('\\', '/');
        if (h.endsWith("/.")) {
            h = h.substring(0, h.length() - 2);
        }
        // On Windows the directory is C:/..., which io.py keeps as /C:/...,
        // its one rooted form; host() turns it back.
        if (!h.startsWith("/")) {
            h = "/" + h;
        }
        return h;
    }

    /// The host path for one of io.py's rooted paths: /C:/data is C:/data on
    /// Windows. Any other path is the host's already.
    private static String host(String path) {
        if (path.length() >= 3 && path.charAt(0) == '/' && path.charAt(2) == ':'
                && Character.isLetter(path.charAt(1))
                && (path.length() == 3 || path.charAt(3) == '/')) {
            return path.length() == 3 ? path.substring(1) + "/" : path.substring(1);
        }
        return path;
    }

    @Override
    public InputStream openInput(String path) throws IOException {
        return new FileInputStream(host(path));
    }

    @Override
    public OutputStream openOutput(String path, boolean append) throws IOException {
        return new FileOutputStream(host(path), append);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean exists(String path) {
        return new File(host(path)).exists();
    }

    @Override
    public boolean isDirectory(String path) {
        return new File(host(path)).isDirectory();
    }

    @Override
    public String[] list(String path) throws IOException {
        String[] r = new File(host(path)).list();
        if (r == null) {
            throw new IOException("not a directory: " + path);
        }
        return r;
    }

    @Override
    public void mkdir(String path) throws IOException {
        if (!new File(host(path)).mkdir()) {
            throw new IOException("cannot create directory: " + path);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void delete(String path) throws IOException {
        if (!new File(host(path)).delete()) {
            throw new IOException("cannot delete: " + path);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void rename(String from, String to) throws IOException {
        File t = new File(host(to));
        // os.rename replaces an existing file, as rename(2) does.
        if (t.exists() && !t.isDirectory() && !t.delete()) {
            throw new IOException("cannot replace: " + to);
        }
        if (!new File(host(from)).renameTo(t)) {
            throw new IOException("cannot rename: " + from);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public long size(String path) {
        return new File(host(path)).length();
    }

    @Override
    public long lastModified(String path) {
        return new File(host(path)).lastModified();
    }
}
